productAdvantages.title: Product Advantages
productAdvantages.description: The product advantages of PT Equityworld Futures are designed to support clients’ trading strategies in an efficient, flexible, and competitive way.

advantages.title: Capital Efficiency
advantages.description: Through the Margin Trading system, clients can manage transactions with large notional values without providing full capital. By allocating around 10% of the contract value as margin, investors can access market opportunities that would normally require much larger capital, allowing for more efficient and strategic use of funds.

advantages.title: Transaction Flexibility
advantages.description: EWF products are designed to support two-way trading strategies, giving clients the opportunity to seek potential returns in both rising and falling markets. This flexibility enables more dynamic risk management and trading approaches.

advantages.title: Competitive Price Movements
advantages.description: The traded instruments offer attractive daily volatility, with typical price ranges of 100–500 points. Combined with a contract size of USD 5 per point and competitive transaction fees, this creates meaningful opportunities to optimize trading results, while still remaining within the applicable regulatory framework.

advantages.title: High Liquidity
advantages.description: All offered products feature strong liquidity. Clients can open and close positions at any time during trading hours without long order queues, enabling fast and efficient trade execution in line with market movements.
